title: Found your nation
note: The coach for the game's own nation builder (conqrun -a), unchanged since 1987. Each step waits for its screen (detect: a regular expression on the 80x24 text). build.py writes web/tutorial/found-nation[.language].json.

steps.title: Name your nation
steps.detect: Enter a Name for your Country
steps.text:
Type your nation's name and press Enter. Up to 9 letters: the field stops at the ninth.

Every ruler sees this name on the map and in the news. It is not your website account.

steps.title: Your nation's password
steps.text:
Type a password for your nation, 2 to 7 characters, and press Enter. Nothing shows while you type.

The game asks for it every time you play, as it did on the Unix machines of 1987. Keep it: only the administrator can reset it.

steps.title: Once more
steps.text: Type the same password again and press Enter.

steps.title: Your ruler
steps.text: The name of your nation's leader, up to 9 letters (the game's own examples: The Ed, Gandalf, Conan), then Enter. The news will speak of them.

steps.title: Race
steps.text:
Press one letter:

  • D Dwarves: strong fighters and miners.
  • E Elves: good defenders, at home with magic.
  • H Humans: balanced, the easiest to start with.
  • O Orcs: they breed fast and fight in numbers.

The race decides which classes you may choose next.

steps.title: Class
steps.detect: Enter the number of your choice
steps.text:
Type the number of a class and press Enter. The list shows which races may take it (D, E, H, O) and the power it starts with.

King and emperor cost no points and suit a first game; the others start with a power that costs some of your points.

steps.title: Alignment
steps.text: Your nation's character: G good, N neutral or E evil. It shapes how the nations run by the computer see you.

steps.title: Your mark on the map
steps.text: Press one of the letters listed. It marks your nation's land on everyone's map.

steps.title: Spend your points
steps.text:
Each line is something your nation can buy; Points Left is what you have.

  • j moves the marker down, k up.
  • Space buys one more of the marked line.
  • l switches to taking back, h to adding again; ? explains the line.

Tip: buy 2 or 3 points of Treasury: a nation without gold cannot draft troops in its first turn. Press Esc when you are done.

steps.title: Points left over
steps.text: Points you did not spend can become people: y (recommended). n takes you back to spend them.

steps.title: Finished?
steps.text: y if your nation is as you want it; n goes back to the points.

steps.title: Save it
steps.text: Press y. Any other key deletes the nation you just built, and you start again.

steps.title: Your nation is in the world
steps.text: Press any key. Your website account is now linked to this nation: from now on Play takes you straight to it, and the game asks for its password.
